parameters.name: context

name: decision.membership
summary: Map a raw raster onto a dimensionless fuzzy membership in [0, 1].

parameters.name: function
parameters.doc: Which membership function to apply.

parameters.name: criterion_name
parameters.doc: Name the criterion carries into the stack; weights bind to it.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: Physical unit of the raw input, for provenance.

parameters.name: x_min
parameters.doc: Low anchor, in the input unit. Taken from the data if absent.

parameters.name: x_max
parameters.doc: High anchor, in the input unit. Taken from the data if absent.

parameters.name: clamp_percentile_low
parameters.doc: Take the low anchor from this percentile instead of the minimum.

parameters.name: clamp_percentile_high
parameters.doc: Take the high anchor from this percentile instead of the maximum.

parameters.name: center
parameters.doc: Inflection point, sigmoidal only. The median if absent.

parameters.name: slope
parameters.doc: Steepness per input unit, sigmoidal only.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.doc: Sigmoidal sense.

parameters.name: mean
parameters.doc: Optimum, gaussian only. The sample mean if absent.

parameters.name: std
parameters.doc: Spread, gaussian only. The sample std if absent.

parameters.name: midpoint
parameters.doc: Value receiving membership 0.5; small/large only.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.doc: Shape exponent; small/large only.

parameters.name: preferred
parameters.doc: Azimuth receiving membership 1; circular only.

parameters.name: angular_spread
parameters.doc: Angular distance receiving membership 0.5; circular only.

parameters.name: mapping
parameters.doc: {class code: membership in [0, 1]}; categorical only. Every code present in the data must be listed.

parameters.name: band
parameters.doc: 1-based band of the input raster.

name: grid.difference
summary: Subtract one raster from another on a shared grid: A - B.

parameters.name: result_name
parameters.doc: Name the difference carries; also the output filename.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: Unit of both inputs; the difference carries the same one.

parameters.name: band
parameters.doc: 1-based band of both inputs.

name: grid.harmonize
summary: Reproject, resample and clip every layer onto one target grid.

parameters.name: target_crs
parameters.doc: CRS of the analysis grid. There is no default.

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.doc: Square pixel of the analysis grid, in the target CRS unit.

parameters.name: layers
parameters.doc: [{path, name, unit, resampling, categorical}], in the order the criteria will carry.

parameters.name: extent_policy
parameters.doc: Intersection keeps only where every layer has data; union keeps where any does. They are different maps.

name: grid.compare_policies
summary: Report the grid and the share of cells that would carry a score under each extent policy, without harmonizing.

parameters.name: target_crs
parameters.doc: CRS of the analysis grid. There is no default.

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.doc: Square pixel of the analysis grid, in the target CRS unit.

parameters.name: layers
parameters.doc: [{path, name, unit, resampling, categorical}], the same shape `grid.harmonize` takes.

parameters.name: estimate_cells
parameters.doc: Budget for the decimated grid the estimate runs on.

name: decision.ahp_weights
summary: Weights from a reciprocal comparison matrix, with the consistency ratio as a refusal.
reference: Saaty (1980), The Analytic Hierarchy Process, ch. 3.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.doc: Square, strictly positive, reciprocal comparison matrix.

parameters.name: names
parameters.doc: Criterion names in the stack's order; row i binds to names[i].

parameters.name: cr_threshold
parameters.doc: Consistency ratio above which the matrix is refused.

parameters.name: override_reason
parameters.doc: Written justification for proceeding above the threshold. Recorded in the manifest.

name: decision.aggregate
summary: Apply memberships and aggregate by Fuzzy Gamma, Product, Sum or weighted linear combination.
reference: Zimmermann and Zysno (1980), Fuzzy Sets and Systems 4(1), sec. 3; Saaty (1980) for the weights.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.doc: [{path, name, unit, function, ...membership params}], all already on one grid.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc: Aggregation operator.

parameters.name: result_name
parameters.doc: Name of the suitability map, and its filename.

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.doc: Compensation for fuzzy_gamma. 0 is the product, 1 the sum. Recorded: 0.7 and 0.9 are different maps.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.doc: [{name, weight}] for weighted_linear_combination; must sum to 1.

parameters.name: mask_path
parameters.doc: Raster mask — an AOI or a common validity mask. Outside it the result is null, not zero.

parameters.name: correlation_threshold
parameters.doc: |r| above which a pair of criteria is reported as possible double counting.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.doc: [{name, group}]; criteria sharing a group are not reported as double counting.

name: grid.idw
summary: Interpolate scattered point samples onto a grid (Shepard 1968).
reference: Shepard, D. (1968), Proc. 23rd ACM National Conference; IMPLEMENTACAO_GEOPOTENTIAL_MSP.md MSP-06.

parameters.name: target_crs
parameters.doc: CRS of the analysis grid. There is no default.

parameters.name: pixel_size
parameters.doc: Square pixel of the analysis grid, in the target CRS unit.

parameters.name: bounds
parameters.doc: (left, bottom, right, top) of the area to grid. Absent, the data's own extent is used; present, only that area is gridded — which is also the cheapest way to make a grid fit.

parameters.name: bounds_crs
parameters.doc: CRS `bounds` is written in, when it is not the target CRS.

parameters.name: result_name
parameters.doc: Name the result carries; also the output filename.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: Physical unit of the samples; the field carries it.

parameters.name: source_crs
parameters.doc: CRS the coordinates are in. Required for a table.

parameters.name: x_field
parameters.doc: Column holding the X coordinate.

parameters.name: y_field
parameters.doc: Column holding the Y coordinate.

parameters.name: value_field
parameters.doc: Column holding the measurement.

parameters.name: layer
parameters.doc: Layer of a multi-layer vector file.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.doc: Search radius. Beyond it no sample is used, and a cell with too few samples stays null rather than being filled from far away.

parameters.name: power
parameters.doc: Shepard's p. Higher weights the nearest sample more; 2 is the documented default.

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.doc: Fewer neighbours than this leaves the cell null.

parameters.name: max_points
parameters.doc: Neighbours used, nearest first.

name: grid.cross_validate

parameters.doc: Column holding the measurement.

parameters.doc: Layer of a multi-layer vector file.

parameters.name: power
parameters.doc: Shepard's p, as grid.idw would run with it.

parameters.name: min_points
parameters.doc: As grid.idw would run with it.

parameters.name: max_points
parameters.doc: As grid.idw would run with it.

parameters.name: max_distance
parameters.doc: As a triangulated method would run with it.

parameters.name: folds

name: scenarios.leave_one_out
summary: Remove each criterion in turn, re-aggregate, and report how far the map and its ranking moved.
reference: Saltelli et al. (2008), Global Sensitivity Analysis: The Primer, ch. 1; IMPLEMENTACAO_GEOPOTENTIAL_MSP.md MSP-11, section 17.3.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.doc: [{path, name, unit, function, ...membership params}], the same list the run was computed from, all on one grid.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc: The aggregation the run used. A scenario measured against a different operator measures nothing.

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.doc: The run's gamma, for fuzzy_gamma.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.doc: [{name, weight}], the run's weights.

parameters.name: top_fraction
parameters.doc: The head of the distribution the agreement is measured over. 0.1 is the top decile; "the best 10 %" is a choice.

name: scenarios.sensitivity
summary: Vary gamma, one weight, or a membership anchor, and report the change in the map and in its ranking.
reference: Saltelli et al. (2008), ch. 1; IMPLEMENTACAO_GEOPOTENTIAL_MSP.md MSP-11, section 17.

parameters.name: criteria
parameters.doc: [{path, name, unit, function, ...membership params}], the same list the run was computed from, all on one grid.

parameters.name: method
parameters.doc: The aggregation the run used. A scenario measured against a different operator measures nothing.

parameters.name: gamma
parameters.doc: The run's gamma, for fuzzy_gamma.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.doc: [{name, weight}], the run's weights.

parameters.name: top_fraction
parameters.doc: The head of the distribution the agreement is measured over. 0.1 is the top decile; "the best 10 %" is a choice.

parameters.name: parameter
parameters.doc: What to vary. `gamma` is the compensation; `weight` moves one criterion's weight and renormalises the rest.

parameters.name: values
parameters.doc: The values to try. A list and not a range: an irregular grid (0, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1) is usually what is wanted.

parameters.name: criterion
parameters.doc: Which criterion's weight to sweep. Required for `weight`, meaningless for `gamma`.

name: scenarios.explain
summary: Decompose one cell's score into what each criterion contributed, with the decomposition named.
reference: Zimmermann and Zysno (1980) for the operators decomposed; IMPLEMENTACAO_GEOPOTENTIAL_MSP.md MSP-12, section 17.1.

parameters.name: row
parameters.doc: Row of the cell to explain.

parameters.name: column
parameters.doc: Column of the cell to explain.

name: scenarios.rank_targets
summary: Rank the highest-scoring places, separated so one anomaly is one target, each with what drove it.

name: potential_fields.derivative
summary: Derivada de primeira ou segunda ordem em x, y ou z (z para baixo).
reference: Blakely (1995), Potential Theory in Gravity and Magnetic Applications, section 12; MSP-14/15.

parameters.name: pad_fraction
parameters.doc: Quanto a grade cresce de cada lado antes da FFT. A diferença entre 10 % e 50 % é visível no resultado, e o valor vai para o manifesto.

parameters.name: taper
parameters.doc: Quanto da região refletida recebe o cosseno. O taper decai para o nível da **borda** do dado, não para a média.

parameters.name: result_name
parameters.doc: Nome do resultado, e do arquivo.

parameters.name: field_kind
parameters.doc: O que este dado é: `gravity`, `magnetic` ou `other`. As transformações que dependem da derivada vertical só são definidas para um campo potencial; a redução ao polo, só para magnético.

parameters.name: axis
parameters.doc: Eixo. z é positivo **para baixo**: a derivada vertical cresce ao aproximar-se da fonte.

parameters.name: order
parameters.doc: 1 ou 2. Ordem 3 multiplica o espectro por |k|³ e o que sai é ruído com a forma do dado.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.doc: Unidade do campo de entrada, para rotular a saída.
